population: Only Larus fuscus birds independently eligible for the previously defined flight 5km D1 balanced and low-speed 100m D1 balanced estimators, using the exact source and saved original outputs; no replacement of species/year or admission gates.
estimand: Bird-level association between flight and low-speed stationary ID-vs-other heldout log-score gains across matched birds (not equal-scale biological effect sizes).
primary_metric: Spearman rho of flight and stationary bird-level original uncalibrated gains for matched bird IDs
null: 9999 random permutations of stationary bird-level gains across the matched birds; two-sided p with (1+abs(null)>=abs(obs))/(10000), seed 20261020. Exploratory pairing null, not a biological causal hypothesis or independent replication.
ci: 5000 simple matched-bird pair bootstraps, percentile 95% Spearman rho; do not treat day/fix as replicates.
secondary: relationship of both gains to scored sessions and matched individuals per source (sampling-effort confound audit)
verification: Do not compute new flying effect statistics; load exact previously checksum-pinned full flight result JSON

Use independent tag registry to avoid counting same study-year multiple times, and clearly report devices inseparable from birds in 2021

interpretation.positive_association: May indicate a shared individual-, location- or tag-linked factor affecting both contexts. Cannot attribute the cause to tag error.
interpretation.null_association: Does not remove instrument artefact in flight because observation error can be state-dependent; different effect scales and sampling make absence uninformative for causality.
interpretation.negative_association: Could represent different ecological states, observation biases, or estimator calibration. No claim of opposite biological strategies.
